hero.body: Featuring a specialized "Notify" Emerald & Lime palette — a lush, cool-toned green that stays vibrant year-round even under intense Arizona sun. Lead-free, pet-friendly, 15-year warranty.

intro.label: About the Series
intro.heading: Cool-Tone Color That Holds Its Vibrance
body: The **Winter Blend Series** features a specialized **"Notify" Emerald & Lime** palette — a lush, cool-toned green that stays vibrant year-round even under intense Arizona sun. Where other turfs fade or yellow, Winter Blend holds true.

Winter Blend 84 is a great residential choice for backyards and side yards. **Winter Blend 103 is ideal for moderate-to-heavy traffic areas** — extra fiber density makes it well-suited to busy families and entertainment zones.
Need help choosing between the two? [Reach out](/contact/) and we'll walk you through your options.

items.heading: Notify Color Palette
items.body: Cool-toned Emerald & Lime stays vibrant year-round under Arizona sun — no fading, no yellowing.

items.heading: CoolYarn + UV-Stable
items.body: Yarn shape improves airflow and resists UV fading from prolonged sun exposure.

items.heading: Pet & Kid Safe
